titulo: Cop31 live: world urged to avoid one of ‘most disappointing Cops ever’ as talks stretch past deadline
cuerpo: Though the climate talks officially finished on Friday, no final deal was agreed. NGOs are warning that this summit might fall disastrously short of what is needed Although not quite deserted, the halls of the Cop31 conference centre are considerably less peopled today. A few people wander back and forth with their backpacks on. Young Turkish support staff walk around in groups. It’s possible to find a seat at the tables next to the food stalls. Those, however, are closed, so there is nothing to actually rest on the table except for your laptop. Continue reading...
